name: UPL Ltd.
business_summary: Global crop-protection, seeds (Advanta) and sustainable agri-solutions group (UPL SAS, UPL Corp) with ~80% of sales outside India (model knowledge). Q2 FY27: sales Rs11,860 cr (flat to lower y/y), OP Rs2,068 cr (17.4%), PAT Rs452 cr (Business Standard) with margin expansion for the eighth straight quarter. TTM sales Rs52,645 cr, interest Rs3,281 cr. Mcap Rs44,238 cr, P/E 23.1, 12m -28%.

revenue_mix.geography: LatAm, N. America, Europe, RoW (model estimate)

exposures.mechanism: SSU +10% global agchem prices/volumes. Revenue +8% (price mostly drops to EBITDA at ~35% flow-through) on Q2 sales 11,860 / EBITDA 2,068 (17.4% margin): EBITDA +8% x 11,860 x 0.35/2,068... ~ +16%; net debt high (EV/MCap ~1.6-1.9, estimate) so equity beta is ~1.7x -> +27% x persistence 0.3 -> +8.

evidence.note: Q2: PAT Rs452 cr (BS) / Rs421 cr attributable (-24% CNBC TV18), EBITDA +5%, eighth straight quarter of margin expansion, sales slipped (Investing.com, Business Standard, AgroSpectrum)

exposures.mechanism: ~80% of revenue outside India (model knowledge) and most debt in USD/BRL; translation lift on EBITDA vs higher INR value of USD debt nearly offset; Brazil real moves matter more. Net +1.0 with wide range.

Series is ZS=F soybean-linked: +10% soy/vegetable-oil prices lift Brazil/US/Argentina farmer incomes and crop-protection spending (~60% of sales LatAm + N. America); +10% -> volume +3% -> EBITDA +6% x EV/MCap 1.7 x0.3 = +3; empirical +2.15 (t +1.8) per +10% agrees in sign; shaded to +1.5.
LatAm ~35% of revenue (model estimate): +1pp growth -> sales +0.5% and credit availability for Brazilian farmers (bad-debt cycle) -> EBITDA +1.5% x1.7 x0.5.
Chinese generic actives set price floor; +15% export push -> prices -4% on 40% of portfolio -> EBITDA -9% x1.7 x0.3... -4.6; shaded -3 as UPL's integrated manufacturing and distribution cushions.
Interest Rs3,281 cr TTM on gross debt ~Rs45k cr (derived); ~40% floating -> +25bp = Rs45 cr = -2% PAT, x persistence 0.5 -> -1.0. Empirical +2.21 (t +1.3) has the wrong sign and is ignored.
India ~20% of sales; +10% monsoon -> domestic sales +5% -> EBITDA +2% x1.7 x0.5.
Intermediates/solvents ~50% of COGS; pass-through limited in competitive markets (~50%). +10% -> costs +5% x50% unrecovered -> EBITDA -8% x1.7 x0.3... -2.4; shaded -1.2.
North America is a minority of revenue and UPL manufactures partly outside India; small exposure.

supply_chain.counterparty: PI Industries, Dhanuka, Bayer, Corteva, Syngenta
